m: उद्-ए (उद्-आ-√ इ) P. -एति (Impv. 2. sg. उदेहि, AV. v, 30, 11, &c.) to go up, rise, arise from, come up, move upwards, RV. vi, 5, 1; AV.; ŚBr.; ChUp.; to move out, come out of, go out, ŚBr.; VS.; to arise, be produced.
उद्-√ एज् P. -एजति, to move upwards, rise, AV. iv, 4, 2; to shake, tremble: Caus. -एजयति, to cause to tremble, shake, Kāś. on Pāṇ. iii, 1, 138.

v: tri॰ ud + eja--Ric--KaS । udvegakArake “udejayAn BUtagaRAn nyazeDIt” BawwiH ।
m: उद्-एजय mfn. shaking, causing to tremble, Pāṇ. iii, 1, 138.
a: उदेजय — a. Shaking, causing to tremble, terrifying; उदेजयान् भूतगणान् न्यषेधीत् Bk. 1. 15.

m: उदेयिवस् mfn. (p.p. P.) that has come up, produced, originated, born, BhP. x, 31, 4.
उद्-एष्यत् mfn. about to rise or mount upwards, about to increase, Śiś. ii, 76.
